description: This source file defines a class 'ConstantHasher' implementing the 'IHasher' interface. The class provides a constant hash value for any input data, primarily used for testing hash collision scenarios in storage tests within an Orleans project.

classes.name: ConstantHasher
classes.description: A hasher that returns a fixed hash value for all inputs to induce hash collisions during testing.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Returns a constant hash value regardless of input data.
